item.title: Edo Security Corps Arrest Hoodlums Over Alleged Robbery, Drug Activities In Oluku - ITV
item.description: Two men, identified as Lucky Otayuwa and Monday Osas, have been arrested by operatives of the Edo State Security Corps over their alleged involvement in robbery and the terrorization of residents in Oluku and its environs. The suspects have since been handed over to the Nigeria Police Force, Ekiadolor Division, for further investigation and prosecution.

item.title: Late Mrs. Mercy Aigbosa Celebrated For Impactful Life - ITV
item.description: A social dance has been held in honour of the late Mrs. Mercy Ekhoemagbomwan Aigbosa, as family, friends, and well-wishers gathered to celebrate her life and enduring legacy. Ofure Anetor reports that she was widely described as a kind, caring, and hardworking woman whose impact will be greatly missed. item.title: Uhie Community Inaugurates New Okhaighele Kingsley Igbinoba - ITV
item.description: The Odionwere of Uhie Community, Pa. Alfred Imafidon, has formally presented the newly appointed Okhaighele, Mr. Kingsley Igbinoba, to the Enogie of Oghobaghase Dukedom, His Royal Highness, Ilerhunmwunwa Akenzua. The ceremony was held at the Enogie’s palace in Obaretin Community on Monday. The report by Ehis Uhunamure is presented by Ikponmwosa Ugiagbe. YouTube: @itvradiong |
